body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new script, `build-semantic-kg-bounded-pilot-candidates.mjs`, along with its test suite and several generated artifacts to build and validate bounded pilot candidates under a no-auth boundary. The code review feedback focuses on enhancing the robustness of this script by recommending defensive programming practices. Specifically, the reviewer suggests adding defensive guards and type checks to utility, mapping, and filtering functions—such as `countBy`, `mapReviewStateFromTriResult`, `mapBlockerReasons`, and `buildChecks`—to gracefully handle nullish, malformed, or non-array inputs and prevent potential runtime `TypeErrors`.
